_meta.description: Open questions register - the decision inputs. Each row states the question, why it blocks a decision, what information already exists, what is missing, and a concrete way to discover the missing information. Nothing downstream of a row moves until the row is answered in data/decisions.json.

questions.question: Are the intended ASINs for P4 and P5 correct, and are those products in scope?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks D-20 (whether to keep them held) and any future shop page for them.
questions.have: Observed destinations (provisional ASINs B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z, both meat thermometers per the predecessor register's 2026-11-17 reads).
questions.missing: The owner's confirmation of what each submitted link was meant to point at.
questions.discovery: Owner opens the two submitted short links, compares them with the registered official listing URLs, and answers in-scope / out-of-scope / different-product.

questions.question: Is the tracking ID shopnow047c-20 registered and active?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks treating any Special Link as attribution-ready (FLG-04) and every downstream conversion question.
questions.have: Owner-supplied ID, format matches the XXXXX-## pattern.
questions.discovery: Associates Central - Account settings - Manage your tracking IDs; screenshot or note the status.

questions.question: Do clicks on the published Special Links report to the Associates dashboard?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks scaling link placements and all measurement claims (FLG-07).
questions.have: Destination checks (right ASINs observed on the final URLs).
questions.missing: One observed click per product in the Associates reporting UI.
questions.discovery: Click each published link once from a normal browser; check Associates Central reports next day; record the result in the intent record's attribution_status.

questions.question: Will the site apply for Creators/PA API access?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks SG-05 (prices/availability/ratings display) and photography path (c) in Q-05.
questions.have: The API's official documentation URL and the carried rules that keep prices off the site today.
questions.discovery: Review the API documentation's eligibility page; decide; record in decisions.json.

questions.question: Which product-photography path is chosen?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks lifting FLG-10 and the shop pages' imagery upgrade.
questions.have: The bar on generated and copied photos (D-13) and the four candidate paths (SG-04).
questions.missing: The choice, plus budget/equipment if path (a), or API access if path (c).
questions.discovery: Pick a path on the Suggestions page; record in decisions.json.

questions.question: Where is the analytics collector hosted?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks real funnel measurement (FLG-08) and SG-06's measured-query switch.
questions.have: A runnable dependency-free collector and the five-event contract.
questions.discovery: Compare the two or three candidate hosts against the retention note in events.json; deploy; set CC_COLLECT_URL.

questions.question: Who owns the Search Console property and its verification?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks query-level topic selection (FLG-09, SG-03, SG-06).
questions.have: A complete sitemap, canonical URLs and shipped structured data.
questions.discovery: Follow SG-03's step list with a Google account that manages the site.

questions.question: What publishing cadence can actually be sustained?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks committing to the 14-day guide cadence beyond the shipped queue.
questions.have: Eight shipped guides; the cadence rule; no data on writing capacity.
questions.missing: An answer on who writes and how often.
questions.discovery: Owner states a sustainable number; the calendar re-bases on it.

questions.question: Is there budget for any tooling (keyword data, stock photography, email tool)?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks the paid options in SG-04, SG-08 and any keyword research beyond Search Console.
questions.discovery: Owner states the monthly ceiling; the suggestion queue re-sorts by what fits.

questions.question: Is 'The Crisp Counter' clear to use as the site name?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks investing in any external asset that carries the name (og images are regenerable; domains and social handles are not).
questions.have: The name, the rationale (D-01), and the fact that no external asset carries it yet.
questions.missing: A quick clearance check for confusingly similar marks in this niche.
questions.discovery: Search the USPTO trademark database for the phrase in class 35/44-adjacent registrations; record the result.

questions.question: If email capture is wanted, what is the consent basis and retention period?
questions.have: RSS as the shipped, obligation-free channel.
questions.missing: Consent basis, retention, privacy notice text, tool choice.
questions.discovery: Decide after Q-06/Q-09; the form ships only with its privacy copy written.

questions.question: Which comparison page conclusion is allowed to say which product 'wins' for a reader profile?
questions.why_it_blocks: Blocks any 'for most people, pick X' sentence: with no measured performance data and attribution unverified, a conclusion would be an unverified claim.
questions.have: Verified spec facts for three formats; the chooser's honest spec-priority output.
questions.missing: Either measured evidence (which this register does not fabricate) or an owner policy call on spec-based conclusions.
questions.discovery: Owner chooses: keep the chooser format-only, or allow spec-based 'if your priority is capacity per centimetre, the 6L dual-basket leads the verified three' sentences (which are checkable arithmetic from carried facts).
